Spas and Hotels Raided for Suspected Sex Trade, Dozens Detained

Authorities conducted raids on 18 spa centers in Gurugram and an OYO hotel in Aligarh, detaining dozens of individuals suspected of involvement in sex trafficking. In Gurugram, 30 women and 20 men were apprehended at 18 spa centers, with suspicions that some individuals might be minors. In Aligarh, police raided an OYO hotel where a sex trade was allegedly operating, taking 7 women and 13 men into custody.
